universal_lens: Statistical inference via data accessibility unifies sports analytics through structured play-by-play repositories. Play-by-play data encodes dynamic hockey states through event types, player roles, and spatial shot distributions, enabling probabilistic modeling of scoring patterns.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian updating of player and team performance metrics using hockeyR's pre-scraped play-by-play data for probabilistic forecasting. GSI employs Bayesian networks to infer player contribution likelihood from event sequences and shot location data, updating belief states via conformal prediction.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine models game states and transitions using event-based state machines derived from NHL play-by-play data. GSE models game progression using Markovian state transitions between play events, incorporating player pairings and positional shifts for tactical decision-making.
